title: Magpie Sky Patrol
description: It's swooping season! Take control of a family of Australian magpies and dive-bomb runners and cyclists to defend your nest. Switch between a pied, a scruffy mottled and a blackback magpie, each with their own carol.

defaultCaptions.x: It's swooping season. I'm the magpie now. Dive-bomb cyclists and runners to defend the nest in Magpie Sky Patrol!
defaultCaptions.facebook: Every spring, the magpies win. Play Magpie Sky Patrol: swoop on runners and cyclists, switch between three magpies and carol to protect your eggs.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Made a 3D game where you're the Australian magpie swooping cyclists in spring
defaultCaptions.discord: Magpie Sky Patrol: swoop cyclists, scare joggers, defend the nest. Can you keep all three eggs?
